info.title: The gesture vocabulary: the words, timings, thresholds and table every surface moves a panel's controls with

GESTURES_HEAD.description: The declaration's own heading: its schema number, its title and its description, as schema/gestures.json opens.

x-value.title: One gesture vocabulary
x-value.description: Every surface moves a panel's controls with these gestures, declared once; each surface maps its own inputs onto them. tools/gestures.mjs is the reference every surface is checked against; docs/panel-gestures.md explains the table. The timings, the thresholds and the table live here and nowhere else in the repo.

GESTURES_TIMINGS.description: The timings, in milliseconds: each a default and a description, the safety hold also a floor a surface may not go below.

longPressMs.description: A press held this long without a drag is a long-press: the word `more`.

doubleTapMs.description: A second tap that begins within this time of the first tap's release is a double-tap.

palmGuardMs.description: Two pointers of one type that both begin inside a control's target within this time of each other are a pinch; a later one is not.

safetyHoldMs.description: How long a control marked `hold` must be held before it acts. A surface may lengthen it and never shorten it below the floor.

claimMs.description: After a step, the control still belongs to the stepper and shows its value text for this long.

GESTURES_THRESHOLDS.description: The thresholds: the drag start in pixels, the fine ratio, the step fraction, the coarse steps and the default travel in pixels.

GESTURES_WORDS.description: The gesture words, in their declared order: what a surface does with an input the table maps to the word.

oneOf.title: drag
oneOf.description: Move the value with the pointer, relative to where the drag began.
oneOf.x-text: Move the value with the pointer, relative to where the drag began.

oneOf.title: fine
oneOf.description: A drag at 0.3 of the drag's travel.
oneOf.x-text: A drag at 0.3 of the drag's travel.

oneOf.title: step
oneOf.description: One declared step, else 1% of the normalised travel; coarse is 5 steps. A wheel notch, an encoder detent and an arrow key are one step.
oneOf.x-text: One declared step, else 1% of the normalised travel; coarse is 5 steps. A wheel notch, an encoder detent and an arrow key are one step.

oneOf.title: second
oneOf.description: A handle's Q, by pinch or encoder 3.
oneOf.x-text: A handle's Q, by pinch or encoder 3.

oneOf.title: reset
oneOf.description: The declared default, and nothing for a control that declares none. A band's reset is its gain: frequency and Q keep.
oneOf.x-text: The declared default, and nothing for a control that declares none. A band's reset is its gain: frequency and Q keep.

oneOf.title: more
oneOf.description: The surface's precise editor or menu. Never a value change.
oneOf.x-text: The surface's precise editor or menu. Never a value change.

oneOf.title: select
oneOf.description: Select a bar or a handle. Never a value change.
oneOf.x-text: Select a bar or a handle. Never a value change.

oneOf.title: toggle
oneOf.description: Flip a switch, on release inside its target.
oneOf.x-text: Flip a switch, on release inside its target.

oneOf.title: paint
oneOf.description: A drag that leaves the pressed bar's column: every bar the pointer enters takes its height, absolute.
oneOf.x-text: A drag that leaves the pressed bar's column: every bar the pointer enters takes its height, absolute.

GESTURES_INPUTS.description: The inputs a surface maps onto the gesture words, in their declared order.

GESTURES_TABLE.description: What each widget does with each input: the word of GESTURES_WORDS. The widget keys are PANEL_STANDARD_WIDGETS of the panel domain, and bar and handle.

GESTURES_PAINT.description: Whether a sweep that paints bars is required or optional, by pointer type.

GESTURES_CODES.description: The refusal codes of a gesture, each naming the rule that refused.

oneOf.title: readOnly
oneOf.description: A read-only control takes no gesture.
oneOf.x-text: A read-only control takes no gesture.

oneOf.title: owned
oneOf.description: The control belongs to the pointer, or the stepper's claim, that has it; a later press is refused.
oneOf.x-text: The control belongs to the pointer, or the stepper's claim, that has it; a later press is refused.

oneOf.title: noDefault
oneOf.description: A reset on a control that declares no default.
oneOf.x-text: A reset on a control that declares no default.

oneOf.title: notInTable
oneOf.description: The widget has no such input in the table.
oneOf.x-text: The widget has no such input in the table.

oneOf.title: holdShort
oneOf.description: A control marked hold was released before the safety hold.
oneOf.x-text: A control marked hold was released before the safety hold.

oneOf.title: holdBelowFloor
oneOf.description: A safety hold shorter than the declared floor.
oneOf.x-text: A safety hold shorter than the declared floor.

oneOf.title: noTarget
oneOf.description: A step with no bar or handle member to take it.
oneOf.x-text: A step with no bar or handle member to take it.

oneOf.title: paintRequired
oneOf.description: Painting is required on touch and cannot be turned off.
oneOf.x-text: Painting is required on touch and cannot be turned off.

oneOf.title: badSetting
oneOf.description: An unknown timing, or one not above zero.
oneOf.x-text: An unknown timing, or one not above zero.

oneOf.title: badInput
oneOf.description: Input neither reference can read: a control whose travel has no ends, an end not above the other, a log travel from zero, a negative step, a drawn length not above zero or a target with no size; an event with no time or no type of the six, a press without a position, id or pointer type, a notch count that is not a number.
oneOf.x-text: Input neither reference can read: a control whose travel has no ends, an end not above the other, a log travel from zero, a negative step, a drawn length not above zero or a target with no size; an event with no time or no type of the six, a press without a position, id or pointer type, a notch count that is not a number.

GESTURES_EXCEPTIONS.description: The section exceptions layered on the table: a section, a widget, an input and the word that replaces the table's.
